spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: [STU-QUIET-005] HEADLESS VISUAL PROOF. Agents visually inspect output through the headless `StudioRenderHarness` (render-to-buffer capture) and Argus on the AccessKit tree. Where headless-GPU pixel readback is unreliable (documented `Harness::render` readback crash class `0xc0000005` on headless-GPU hosts), the harness MUST fall back to AccessKit-tree/state assertions and run pixel screenshots on a real-GPU host, never blocking on foreground automation. --- --- ## 14.21 Operator Unification Surface Studio MUST also work as ONE unified operator-facing creative application that replaces the five source suites for a human operator. This sub-section is normative.

[STU-VAL-004] VISUAL INSPECTION DUTY. A model MUST inspect BOTH structured output (document-model diffs, receipts, exported-file integrity) AND rendered visual output (canvas/screenshot capture via `StudioRenderHarness` + Argus) before claiming a Studio edit done. Proposal receipts (14.18) carry before/after evidence references.

[STU-MDL-002] FRONTEND VISIBILITY. Every operator-visible Studio surface (pane, panel, tab, tool, control, canvas) MUST expose a stable `author_id` target through the native AccessKit/egui accessibility tree so Argus can identify, inspect, and steer it. The frontend MUST expose machine-readable UI-state snapshots (which tool is active, current selection, panel/layout state, document/artboard focus) queryable without pixel screen-reading.

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.

patch_provenance.preserved: The original acceptance prose is kept verbatim at scope.acceptance_criteria_original. No clause, scope decision, path list or obligation from the original contract was removed.

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: [STU-QUIET-005] HEADLESS VISUAL PROOF. Agents visually inspect output through the headless `StudioRenderHarness` (render-to-buffer capture) and Argus on the AccessKit tree. Where headless-GPU pixel readback is unreliable (documented `Harness::render` readback crash class `0xc0000005` on headless-GPU hosts), the harness MUST fall back to AccessKit-tree/state assertions and run pixel screenshots on a real-GPU host, never blocking on foreground automation. --- --- ## 14.21 Operator Unification Surface Studio MUST also work as ONE unified operator-facing creative application that replaces the five source suites for a human operator. This sub-section is normative.

[STU-VAL-004] VISUAL INSPECTION DUTY. A model MUST inspect BOTH structured output (document-model diffs, receipts, exported-file integrity) AND rendered visual output (canvas/screenshot capture via `StudioRenderHarness` + Argus) before claiming a Studio edit done. Proposal receipts (14.18) carry before/after evidence references.

[STU-MDL-002] FRONTEND VISIBILITY. Every operator-visible Studio surface (pane, panel, tab, tool, control, canvas) MUST expose a stable `author_id` target through the native AccessKit/egui accessibility tree so Argus can identify, inspect, and steer it. The frontend MUST expose machine-readable UI-state snapshots (which tool is active, current selection, panel/layout state, document/artboard focus) queryable without pixel screen-reading.

implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

scope_basis.verbatim: [STU-MDL-002] FRONTEND VISIBILITY. Every operator-visible Studio surface (pane, panel, tab, tool, control, canvas) MUST expose a stable `author_id` target through the native AccessKit/egui accessibility tree so Argus can identify, inspect, and steer it. The frontend MUST expose machine-readable UI-state snapshots (which tool is active, current selection, panel/layout state, document/artboard focus) queryable without pixel screen-reading.

original_scope.summary: Create the headless StudioRenderHarness (render-to-buffer capture) with AccessKit-tree/state fallback where headless-GPU pixel readback is unreliable (0xc0000005 class); runs pixel screenshots on real-GPU hosts. Enables model visual inspection of output without foreground.
expected_tests: test: harness renders to buffer on real-GPU; falls back to AccessKit-tree assertion on headless
test: no foreground window / no focus steal
acceptance_criteria_original: render harness captures headlessly; AccessKit fallback; quiet (no focus steal)
